question: Can killing even a cow or twice-born person avoid sin when done by prescribed method?
premises: Killing a cow or a twice-born person is mentioned.
The killing is performed according to the prescribed method.
The agent is not tainted by sins in that case.
inference: When performed according to the prescribed method, even such killing does not result in taint by sin.
uncertainties: The ritual conditions defining vidhinā are not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Having killed a cow or even a twice-born person according to the prescribed method, one is not tainted by sins.
